verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a SaaS compliance and registered-agent service, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge and the legacy host redirects into it. No page content about telemetry, analytics, or tracking opt-out was ever retrieved, so there is no evidence of the capability.
